calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was, p.subcategory AS sub_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, p.category, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.category AS cat_is, n.cat_was, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gm,
       ROUND(100.0*SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost)/SUM(n.net_sales),2) AS gm_pct
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-11-30'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.standard_cost, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sales_line_id
LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c, MIN(sales_line_id) keep_id, MAX(sales_line_id) drop_id
  FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1
)
SELECT f.store_key, f.sale_date, COUNT(*) AS dup_rows_total, MAX(d.c) AS max_copies,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.sales_line_id = d.drop_id THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS extra_net,
       MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT drop_id FROM dups)) AS returns_on_dropped
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d ON d.receipt_id=f.receipt_id AND d.line_no=f.line_no
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

SELECT s.store_id = 900 AS is_web_store, f.channel_code, w.status, (w.web_order_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_order, w.dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL AS no_dispatch,
       COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-15' AND DATE '2025-11-05' AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

net_lines AS (

    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key

    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT n.business_date, n.store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS v FROM net_lines n
  WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales AS c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-22' AND DATE '2025-10-26' AND store_id <> 999
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_cmp, SUM(COALESCE(v,0)) AS mine_total, SUM(COALESCE(c,0)) AS ctl_total,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(v,0)-COALESCE(c,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_differ,
       SUM(COALESCE(v,0)-COALESCE(c,0)) AS gap
FROM mine FULL OUTER JOIN ctl USING (business_date, store_id)

SELECT cp.category, COUNT(*) AS lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost > f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_gt_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_net,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=6 AND cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical')
